summary: security checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet; blocked for the gated product’s public exposure. Risk severity is high due to unavailable fleet-doctor and operations sweeps: authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, incident monitoring, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unknown. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance records 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: retain ordinary low-risk growth already authorized, but authorize no security-sensitive go-live, public exposure, credential or permission changes, configuration changes, alert expansion, or deployment until required controls are evidenced. Continue bounded read-only evidence capture only; do not treat missing telemetry as a pass or request duplicate telemetry.

Security review confirms the two CRO prototypes are not security blockers if they remain disposable, isolated, dependency-install-free, non-sensitive, and non-production. Because CTO and CFO declined them for this cycle, retain no new prototype work. Reconsider only with explicit security review covering dependency provenance, input handling, artifact isolation, and removal of prototype outputs.

Exact gated-product decision: keep private. Rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, owner, and security evidence remain incomplete. Permit only bounded read-only evidence work and internal draft preparation; do not expose publicly, expand alerts, change credentials or configuration, deploy, spend, or send external requests without owner approval and required human review.

items.title: Capture fleet security control evidence and maintain evidence-needed disposition

Preserve unknowns where fleet-doctor or operations evidence is unavailable.
items.requested_action: Review authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Document timestamps, owners, affected scope, exact unknowns, severity, and release implications. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or change production.
